arabic_text: إِنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَيُّ الإِسْلَامِ أَفْضَلُ؟ فَقَالَ: تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلَامَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ
english_translation: A man asked the Messenger of Allah: Which Islam is best? He said: Feed others, and greet with peace those you know and those you do not know.
question: According to this hadith, what did the Prophet (pbuh) say is the best form of Islam?

options.A: Praying five times daily and fasting in Ramadan
options.B: Performing Hajj and giving Zakat regularly
options.C: Feeding others and greeting with peace those you know and don't know
options.D: Reading the Quran and making dhikr constantly

question: What important Islamic teaching about social interaction does this hadith establish?

options.A: Muslims should spread peace and kindness universally, not just to those they know
options.B: Muslims should only greet other Muslims with salam
options.C: Feeding others is only required during Ramadan
options.D: Greeting strangers is forbidden in Islam
